name: Quinn's Syllabus
tagline: Reading, media, practical. The teacher is the demonstration, not the demonstrator.
body:
THE PORNY PROFESSOR. Quinn Lutinia — Eden's younger sister — teaches the system her older sister built the first step of, to rooms full of women who are about to have bodies they have never had.

THE COURSE IS IN THREE EQUAL THIRDS, and it is called NEREID DYNAMICS.

THE FIRST THIRD IS AN ACTUAL LECTURE — Project Nereid, and how affirmed bodies are built and behave. Not a pep talk and not a pamphlet. A lecture.

THE SECOND THIRD IS LIVED-IN RESOURCES, made by residents: novels by SIREN, specifically about dynamics OTHER than Quinn's own, which means the woman does research. MERCEDES' CAMSTREAMS showcasing the kinks themselves, and SAPPHIRA — the other slut, who makes the resources Quinn teaches from — teaching kinks, PREPARATION and the practical side. Visual learning on dynamics and kinks, because a paragraph can say what a thing is and cannot show a woman what it looks like when it is working — and some of them come out of that clinic having never once seen two bodies do this without something ugly attached. THE THIRD THIRD IS FIELD DEMONSTRATION, and it runs on Briar's judgement rather than a timetable: it happens when BRIAR decides YUP, QUINN NEEDS TO BE BENT OVER HER DESK NOW. She bends Quinn over in front of the class to demonstrate brat-top and eager receiver.

THE TEACHER IS THE ONE TAKEN. Quinn does not stand at the front and top Briar to show them how it is done. She goes over the desk, willingly, joyfully, and her role in her own classroom is EAGER RECEIVER.

EVERY WOMAN IN THAT ROOM CAME OUT OF A PLACE WHERE A BODY GOT DEMONSTRATED ON. The first thing Quinn shows them is a woman putting her own body on the table on purpose, in front of witnesses, delighted about it, and it is HERS the entire time and everyone watching can see that it is hers. That cannot be taught with a diagram.

AND THE READING IS A DIRTY NOVEL written by a woman with her hand between her legs and revised by getting railed to it. Every girl who comes through that classroom learns what she is about to become from a book made entirely out of somebody's joy — not a pamphlet, not a clinical file with a flight number at the top and a threat assessment underneath.

QUINN GOES COMMANDO. She says it is so Briar has less to remove. Efficiency is real. So is the breeze. And so is the third reason — standing in front of a room explaining a system while being the only person in the building who knows there is nothing under the dress.
rules: ONE: an actual lecture on Project Nereid and affirmed bodies
TWO: lived-in resources — Siren's novels, Mercedes' camstreams, Sapphira on kinks and preparation
THREE: field demonstration, scheduled by Briar deciding it is time
Quinn teaches from the receiving position
The curriculum is erotica by residents, and it is accurate
